chunks: From him, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“The muhsan is stoned, and the one whose marriage contract has been concluded but who has not yet consummated with her is lashed one hundred times and banished for one year.”

key_terms.أُمْلِكَ: has had the marriage contract concluded
key_terms.اَلْمُحْصَنُ: the legally protected married person subject here to the ruling of rajm
key_terms.يُرْجَمُ: is stoned as the prescribed punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for zina by a muhsan and by one who is married by contract but has not consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning prescribed punishments for zina. It distinguishes between the muhsan and one who has concluded a marriage contract but has not consummated it, assigning a different hadd to each case.
